name: BioNeutra Global Corporation
summary: BioNeutra Global Corporation, along with its associated companies, specializes in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of food ingredients. These ingredients are designed for use in nutraceuticals, functional foods, and conventional food and beverage products, with a particular emphasis on oligosaccharides. The company's primary offering is VitaFiber, an isomalto-oligosaccharide (IMO) that serves as a functional health food ingredient. This unique component delivers low-calorie, soluble prebiotic fiber, significantly supporting human digestive well-being. BioNeutra supplies a diverse clientele, encompassing both small-to-medium enterprises and various larger food manufacturers, with its market presence spanning across Canada, the United States, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, and Southeast Asia. VitaFiber is also made accessible directly to consumers via e-commerce platforms like Amazon.com and Shopify.com, in addition to other direct-to-consumer retail avenues. The corporation maintains its headquarters in Edmonton, Canada.
